editorial.blurb: Takumi Ramen is a dimly lit, quiet gem serving some of the city's most flavorful ramen bowls with broth that lives up to the hype—and at better prices than comparable high-quality spots.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the tonkotsu ramen if you want rich, deep broth without the saltiness that plagues other ramen places; the spicy miso ramen is genuinely spicy, so order accordingly based on your heat tolerance.
